outcome: BMI trajectory from birth to adolescence
Association between cord blood metabolites and BMI trajectory
cohort: 946 children from the Boston Birth Cohort, a sample of predominantly Black and Hispanic children from low-income families in the US.
finding: Two cord blood metabolomic network modules, primarily composed of triacylglycerols and diacylglycerols, were inversely associated with early-onset overweight and obesity, while cholesterol esters showed a positive association.
